records.failureSummary: Authored test/persist.test.mjs: 9 AC-numbered unit tests for the FR1 persistence primitives in src/persist.mjs, one temp directory per test (mkdtemp under os.tmpdir) cleaned up via t.after. Coverage: [AC-01] loadData missing file returns exactly { items: [], nextId: 1 }; [AC-02] truncated and non-JSON content return the exact fallback; [AC-03] structurally invalid payloads (non-object number/string/null/array, items not array, nextId not number, nextId 0) return the exact fallback without throwing; [AC-04] valid content returns the exact persisted items and nextId; [AC-05] saveData creates a missing nested parent directory a/b/c; [AC-06] successful save leaves only the target file with no *.tmp and complete parseable JSON; [AC-07] a second saveData replaces the previous contents; [AC-08] saveData rejects with a real fs error code for an unwritable path; [AC-09] temp dirs are isolated under the OS temp root. Red phase was demonstrated without modifying product code by running the same AC tests against the original pre-implementation placeholder (loadData/saveData throwing '尚未实现') in an isolated scratch module: that run failed 9/9 (originally 8/9, because the first AC-08 only asserted some rejection and passed even on the placeholder; I strengthened it to require a real fs error code, after which AC-08 fails on the placeholder too). Against the real implementation the 9 FR1 tests pass and the whole repo suite is 17 pass / 0 fail, lint exits 0. All scratch red-phase files were removed; git status shows only test/persist.test.mjs from this task plus the pre-existing dependency-task diffs to src/persist.mjs and src/store.mjs, which I did not touch. No product code was changed.
